reason: I use the factory film on the aluminium for nothing and I spend about 1,900 a year on protection. EUR 19 a m2 plus a deposit up front is far more than I would ever pay for this, and I do not pay deposits.
objection: EUR 19 a m2 for something that peels off, and 50% deposit when I pay my own suppliers at 60 to 90 days. It does not make sense on my margins.
instead: Keep the factory film on the frames, and tape and cheap cover film where needed. Cover the glass myself with board or film if it matters.
would_change_my_mind: A price near EUR 3 to 4 a m2 all-in, no deposit, 60 days payment, and a local contractor I know who says it saved him real glass claims.
